description: This file defines the generic class `Versioned<T>`, which encapsulates a versioned data entry with support for version comparison and updating mechanisms.

classes.name: Versioned
classes.description: A generic class that manages a versioned data entry, supporting version comparison, updates, and retrieval of contained value and version.

methods.name: Versioned
methods.description: Constructor creating a versioned entry with specified version and value.

methods.name: Versioned
methods.description: Constructor creating a versioned entry with a generated UUID as version and given value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates a new versioned object with updated content if the provided resource version matches the current version or is empty.

methods.name: isVersionMatch
methods.description: Checks if the provided resource version matches the current version, considering empty optional as match.
